job: อ่านเมืองผ่านแบรนด์: เห็นก่อนว่าแบรนด์กระจุกอยู่ย่านใด แล้วเจาะลงถึงศูนย์การค้า อาคาร และจุดขายพร้อมหลักฐาน
audiences: ทีมแบรนด์และขยายสาขา
ทีมศูนย์การค้าและเจ้าของสินทรัพย์
นักวิเคราะห์และที่ปรึกษาด้านทำเล
journey: เห็นข้อค้นพบระดับย่านและแผนที่ย่านทันที ไม่ต้องตั้งค่าตัวกรอง
สำรวจ 3 ย่านอันดับต้นด้วยการกดครั้งเดียว ส่วนอื่นของแผนที่เงียบลง
เปิดโปรไฟล์ย่าน: บุคลิกตามกลุ่มแบรนด์ สถานที่ แบรนด์เฉพาะ/ร่วม
เจาะสถานที่และร้าน อ่านสถานะ หลักฐาน และระดับความแม่นของพิกัด
เปรียบเทียบย่านด้วยกราฟและตาราง แล้วคัดรายการไปสำรวจ

scopeRows.definition: rows after search/cohort/segment/province/channel/venue filters, before neighborhood selection and area focus

baseRows.definition: scopeRows narrowed by the selected neighborhood
consumers: aha when a neighborhood is selected

rows.definition: baseRows narrowed by the explore-top-3 area focus

rowScopes.visibleCue: chart scope caption appends ‘เทียบทุกย่าน ไม่รวมการเลือกย่าน’ whenever rows ≠ scopeRows

firstAha.scope: baseRows (scopeRows narrowed by a selected neighborhood when present)
firstAha.ranking: top three fixed neighborhoods by distinct brand labels, POS count, stable ID
firstAha.headlineTemplate: {sharePercent}% ของแบรนด์ที่เลือกอยู่ใน {areaCount} ย่านนี้
firstAha.numerator: union of distinct source brand labels assigned to the top neighborhoods
firstAha.denominator: all distinct brand labels in baseRows, including rows outside defined neighborhoods
firstAha.secondaryFinding: neighborhood with the most exclusive brands within scopeRows (profile-model.js#buildOverviewInsights)
firstAha.action: สำรวจ {areaCount} ย่านนี้

fallbacks.noRows: ไม่พบจุดขายตามตัวกรองนี้ + clear filter action
fallbacks.rowsOutsideAllAreas: explain rows are outside the ten defined cores and rank venues with profile-model.js#rankVenues

requirements: No login, sharing or geolocation prerequisite
Core dataset and neighborhood boundaries enable the area Aha; counts and table still work without boundaries; the map vendor loads separately
Snapshot values are regression fixtures, never UI constants
Returning to all clears only area focus

mapFocusContract.principle: Show detail only for the focused part; keep everything else quiet (owner instruction 2026-10-22)

overview.focus: all defined areas filled by distinct brands (count family, 5 equal-interval classes), labels with counts
overview.quiet: pins are 3–5 px dots below zoom 13.5, no logos

exploreTop3.focus: the three areas keep their fill and emphasis outline; category pins and logos inside
exploreTop3.quiet: other areas outline-only with quiet labels; rows outside focus become grey context dots without logos, aria-hidden, not in the tab order

neighborhood.focus: selected area fill below zoom 14.5, selected outline, host buildings, category pins, logos

store.focus: selected pin ring, leader line to the source coordinate, desktop popup

choropleth.metric: distinct brand labels per defined neighborhood within scopeRows
choropleth.classification: equal-interval, 5 classes from the current maximum, integer closed intervals shown in the legend
choropleth.themePolicy: identical light HEX on both themes; fill-opacity 1 under the basemap's first line layer; hard switch off at zoom ≥ 14.5

mapFocusContract.hostBuildings: map.activeLayer role (light #347DA8 / dark #65B6DB), only for rows in focus, zoom ≥ 14

panel.navigation: back stack (max 20); mode and id restored from URL (?neighborhood, ?place, ?store)

models.neighborhood: js/profile-model.js#buildNeighborhoodProfile (uses scopeRows so exclusive/shared keeps the whole selection as reference)

panel.renderer: js/panel.js (pure HTML strings, delegated data-action clicks)

data.observationGrain: one declared brand store/counter/POS observation; repeated source records are not silently merged
data.closurePolicy: Retain permanently closed records and factual closure status; exclude from the default current view; never delete to improve counts
data.coordinatePolicy: Preserve original geographic coordinates; marker displacement is screen-space only; precision is described from geometryRole/geometryStatus and never upgraded

visualSystem.appliedTokens: assets/theme.css (foundation pairs, semantic states, map roles, data states, series 1–10, count classes)

locationProfile.reason: profile defines business metrics (demand, supply, market size …) that this dataset does not carry

invariants.rule: One store observation owns one pin; no clustering or aggregation, including quiet context pins
250 logo labels is a ceiling, never a quota; logos only at zoom ≥ 13.5 and only for rows in focus
Preserve original logo artwork; use the verified local sprite and restrained framing
Default first insight concerns neighborhoods, not venues; venues are the fallback only when no defined area has rows
Never sum distinct brands across areas; use set union
Keep generic caveats and workflow notes out of UI; retain provenance in documentation and real closure/error states
No decorative bracket or colored left rail; keep visible focus
No fabricated coordinates, store openings, administrative boundaries or consumer behavior claims
Pins, counters, table and panel counts use the same committed rows; Aha, choropleth and charts use scopeRows and say so when they differ
Detail only for the focused part; everything else stays visible but quiet (no logos, grey dots, outline-only areas)
Analytical colours keep the approved light HEX on both themes; contrast is solved with labels, outlines and backplates, never by recolouring data
Exclusive/shared and the Aha denominator reference the whole filtered scope, never a single selected area

chartContracts.title: ย่านที่มีแบรนด์
chartContracts.question: ย่านใดมีแบรนด์หลากหลาย
chartContracts.encoding: horizontal bars; bar fill = count class of the area
chartContracts.metric: distinct brand labels per assigned neighborhood

chartContracts.title: บุคลิกของย่าน
chartContracts.question: ย่านใดเด่นแบรนด์กลุ่มไหน
chartContracts.encoding: numeric heat table; cell tint = count class of the cell value; 0 shown with zero outline
chartContracts.metric: distinct brand labels per neighborhood × segment

chartContracts.title: แบรนด์เฉพาะ / ร่วม
chartContracts.question: แต่ละย่านมีแบรนด์ต่างหรือซ้ำกับย่านอื่นเพียงใด
chartContracts.encoding: stacked horizontal bars with shape cues
chartContracts.metric: brands assigned to exactly one versus multiple neighborhoods
chartContracts.reference: all assigned neighborhoods in scopeRows, before display truncation
